expect_red: [real] the mark stays at the end of its row, including on the rows whose name needs two lines

mutations.contract: The rail's status mark sits at the END of its row, on the rows that make it a question -- a study name needing two lines in 300px must not push the icon onto a third line of its own, left-aligned under the text.
mutations.note: The browser-only defect of that handoff: markup, classes and the DOM shim's geometry are identical either way, so only a layout engine can see it. Enrolling it needed a guard edit first -- the check's name was built by template interpolation (`${wrapped.twoLine} rows`), and an interpolated name can never be declared here: `expect_red` is compared to the printed name for EQUALITY and paired against this file's SOURCE on every pytest run. The count moved to the diagnostic line beside the check.
